QuestInfo.name: Leaving the Pond
QuestInfo.0: You heard that mysterious voice again. Ask the Elder for advice.
QuestInfo.1: If you want to reach the pinnacle of strength, find the Forest of the Priest in Leafre.
QuestInfo.2: You met with Legor, the Bowman Priest, in the Forest of the Priest.\n

0.0: You've made me proud, #h0#. But you're starting to remind me of a big fish in a small pond. If you want to leave that pond, go to Leafre, village of the Halflingers, and find the Forest of the Priest.\r\n\r\n#r(If you accept, you'll travel there automatically.)

yes.0: The wise priests of that forest will guide you from now on.

no.0: Very well. We all must do what we think is right.

1.0: You seek ever greater perception? I welcome you. I am Legor, the Bowman Priest.

npc.0: Your next destination is Leafre. Why waste your time here?
